notes.title: Shape Puzzle Update 1.2
notes.content:
With this update it will be easier to distinguish some nodes. I also added options to the settings menu to change the colour of nodes and pattern. By default you can just change the look of +/- nodes. When you unlock puzzle 60 and 80 you get new colours to customize the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283603/49f5e72e958bced97f15ef95d41ba98e5a897613.png

Within the first quarter of 2023 I will also release the shape puzzle soundtrack on steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971020/Shape_Puzzle_Soundtrack/

Changelog


 Added to the settings menu a customization panel. To change the colour of nodes
 Added a hint to puzzle 61
 Changed the background of +/- nodes to be darker
 Added 1 new achievement
 Added more variation to endless mode puzzles

notes.title: Endless mode update
notes.content:
With this update, I am adding the requested endless mode to the game. After you have played the first 60 puzzles of the normal mode, you get access to the endless mode. This is necessary because in normal mode you get to know each tile.


In addition, you will be rewarded with three new Achievements for playing endless mode. In the Steam Achievements overview, you can also see how many puzzles you have already solved in Endless Mode and how many you need for the next Achievements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283603/7837abe72488f79dfc84d6717e3969c0dfe0b5de.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283603/c18d8d7e96e9ffe259ebb12086e76b33e73d85a3.png
Future Updates
I plan to add at least 2 new tile types to the game, one of them will have the name "Inverter", guess what this tile will do in the comments. I also want to add options to customise the game, i.e. change the general look of the tiles and the background. And of course I will add more variations to the endless mode and improve the performance. I'm also working on settings for the endless mode. So you can choose whether you want to play difficult puzzles or not.

All upcoming work will be published in Development Diaries. 

As always, feel free to give me feedback on the update or tell me what you still miss in the game.


Have a nice week


Changelog

notes.title: Release postponed
notes.content:
Hi all,

First of all, I would like to thank everyone who has already put Shape Puzzle on their wishlist. During SteamNextFest I received a lot of new feedback from players of the demo on the Steam discussion page and on Twitter. Therefore, I have decided to postpone the release to implement your feedback.

The release is not not today ([strike]20th June[/strike]). It is now saturday the 16th July.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283603/02bac2bd2fffe541b6232ac1aa91e15729e296b5.png

Feel free to leave further feedback Steam discussion page or contact me directly on Twitter.

If you haven't played the demo yet, you can still play it on Steam. The pogress will stay when you upgrade to the full game.

Have a good week!
